main_text.p: rare se, Invalescere: Numerosum esse: item Claudere. Pihel עָצַם Exasperare, Ossa comminuere: Claudere. Hiphil הֶעֱצִים Corroboravit, Potentem effecit.
עָצוּם m. Robustus, Potens, Numerosus: plur. עֲצוּמִים Fœm. עֲצוּמוֹת Robora.
עֶצֶם c. Os ossis: Corpus, Substantia: & Pronominaliter, Ille ipse, Hic ipse, Ipsemet: בְּעַצְמוֹ עַצְמְךָ Ego ipse, Ipsemet, Tu ipse, Per se ipsum: plur. עֲצָמִים Ossa, & famin. עֲצָמוֹת.
עָצַר Claudere, Occludere, Continere, Retinere, Cohibere. Niphal נֶעְצַר Cohiberi, Detineri, Claudi.
עֲצָרָה, עֲצָרֹת f. Interdictio, Prohibitio: Dies interdicti. Festum, Feria, quando certa de causa prohibitum erat opus servile, ut tanto liberius sacris vacarent: plurah עֲצָרוֹת.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew words in the running head and entries are uncertain in the scan; the Hebrew forms are transcribed as best read. The printed page is faded with stains; some Latin words (e.g. "Exasperare", "Pronominaliter") may be imperfect.
